item.title: Docker Sandbox Kits: a Dockerfile for what your agent is allowed to touch
item.description: Docker published the Sandbox Kit Specification, an open format for packaging an environment for an AI agent together with a list of what that environment needs from the outside world. A Dockerfile tells you what’s inside the image. A Kit also says what the image will want from outside: network destinations, credentials, volumes, tools, and context for the agent. The Kit doesn’t grant any of it, though. It asks. The runtime decides what to give and enforces the limits.
